bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Irish Red and White Setters: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Irish Red and White Setter series closes at about 16 weeks.

Size class large does not invent new viruses for the Irish Red and White Setter, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final DA2PP / DHPP booster.
Flag progressive retinal atrophy (pra) at Irish Red and White Setter vaccine checkups so the puppy’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Irish Red and White Setter series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Irish Red and White Setter misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Irish Red and White Setter series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Irish Red and White Setter is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Irish Red and White Setter away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Irish Red and White Setter due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Irish Red and White Setter core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Irish Red and White Setter misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Irish Red and White Setter health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Irish Red and White Setter adult health guide for breed predispositions such as hip dysplasia, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
